DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お手続きの後に、確認したいことがありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is there anything you would like to check after completing the procedure?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 友達に振り込みました。連絡する時に、「もう受け取った」と言ってよいのか迷っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 振込後の友人連絡で受取済と言ってよいか相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: I transferred money to a friend. When I contact them, I am unsure whether I can say, “You have already received it.”
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether you can tell a friend they have received the money after a transfer. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: こちらの手続きの状況をご案内します。相手の方は、口座を確認されていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: I can explain the status of your transaction here. Has the recipient checked their account?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: まだ聞いていません。私の控えがあることと、相手が確認したことは違いますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 相手未照会で自分控えと相手確認を区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: I have not asked yet. Having my transaction receipt and having the recipient confirm it are different things.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you have not asked the recipient and distinguish your receipt from their confirmation. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 控えで確認できる内容と、相手に確かめていただくことを分けましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let us separate what the receipt confirms from what the recipient needs to check.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい。まず私が手続きをした時刻と金額を伝えます。相手の確認まで代わりに言うのはやめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 自分の処理時刻金額のみ伝え相手状況を代弁しないと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. First I will tell them the time I completed the transfer and the amount. I will avoid speaking for them about whether they have checked it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you will report only your transaction time and amount and will not speak for the recipient about their situation. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 控えの取引内容を確認されますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Would you like to check the transaction details on your receipt?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: お願いします。相手へ控えの写真を送る場合、私の情報も写るので、必要な部分を考えてからにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 控え写真の自己情報を考え共有範囲を確認したいと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes, please. If I send the recipient a photo of the receipt, it will also show my information, so I will first think about which parts are necessary.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you want to consider your personal information in the receipt photo and check what to share. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 情報の共有はご自身でご注意ください。ご不明な取引状況はこちらへご相談ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please take care when sharing your information. Ask us about any transaction status you do not understand.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。控えを保管して、自分が振り込んだと知らせます。相手の確認ができたかは本人に尋ねます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 控え保管し振込実施を知らせ相手へ本人確認を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. I will keep the receipt and let them know I made the transfer. I will ask them directly whether they have checked it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will keep the receipt, report making the transfer, and ask the recipient personally whether they have confirmed it. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。それでは、控えの内容をご説明します。ご利用ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Certainly. I will now explain the receipt details. Thank you for using our services.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 買い物メモがぬれてしまったのですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Has your shopping list gotten wet?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。野菜を見ている時にぬれました。紙の字がにじんで、あと何を買うか分からなくなりました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 野菜売場で濡れたメモがにじみ不足商品を読めないと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. It got wet while I was looking at vegetables. The writing on the paper has run, and I no longer know what else to buy.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that your list got wet in the vegetable section, the writing ran, and you cannot read the remaining items. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 商品もぬらしたり、汚したりしていませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Have any products gotten wet or dirty as well?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 紙だけです。かごの外で持っていました。野菜の名前が読めない所があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 紙のみ濡れかご外所持で品名不明と説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: Only the paper. I was holding it outside the basket. There are vegetable names I cannot read.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that only the paper got wet, you held it outside the basket, and you cannot read some item names. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 商品についてのご質問なら、ご案内できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: I can help you with questions about the products.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。家族が書いたメモなので、似た字から品物を決める前に、家族へ連絡したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 家族作成メモなので類似字で推測せず本人へ連絡すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: Thank you. My family wrote the list, so I want to contact them before choosing items by guessing from similar-looking letters.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that because your family wrote the list, you will contact them instead of guessing from similar-looking letters. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 連絡が取れる間に、商品をゆっくりお確かめください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please take your time checking the products while you get in touch with them.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。すでに選んだ物を先に整理します。にじんだ紙を商品の上に広げず、かばんの中の袋に入れます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 選定品を整理し濡れ紙は商品に乗せず別袋へ収納すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. I will first organize the items I have already chosen. I will put the smudged paper in a bag inside my handbag instead of spreading it over the products.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will organize the selected items and put the wet paper in a separate bag instead of on the products. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 通路をふさがない場所で確認されてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please check it somewhere you will not block the aisle.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。家族に必要な野菜をもう一度送ってもらい、確認できた物だけ選びます。案内が必要ならまた声をかけます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 家族から野菜名再送後に確認済品のみ選ぶと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. I will ask my family to send the names of the vegetables we need again and choose only the items I can confirm. I will ask you again if I need help.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will have your family resend the vegetable names and choose only confirmed items. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。それでは、ごゆっくりお買い物ください。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Certainly. Please enjoy your shopping. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お花の記録について、ご相談ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like to ask about recording the flowers?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。地域の人が季節の写真を集めているので、今日ここで見た花を送ろうと思います。公園の花の情報も知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 地域写真収集へ今日見た花を送るため情報相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. Local people are collecting seasonal photos, so I am thinking of sending photos of the flowers I saw here today. I would also like information about the park's flowers.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask for information so you can send photos of flowers you saw today to a local photo collection. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: どの場所で、何時ごろ見ましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Where did you see them, and at about what time?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 十時ごろ、池の近くです。写真は三枚ありますが、どれも同じ一本の木です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 十時の池付近で同一本の木を三枚撮影と説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: Near the pond, around ten. I have three photos, but they all show the same tree.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you took three photos of the same tree near the pond at ten. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 公園全体の様子ではなく、その場所でご覧になった記録なのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: So this records what you saw in that spot, rather than the state of the entire park.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい。三枚撮ったから三本咲いているとは書かず、一本を角度を変えて撮ったと説明したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 三写真を三本開花の記録とせず角度違いと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. I do not want to write that three trees were blooming just because I took three photos. I want to explain that I photographed one tree from different angles.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain that the three photos show different angles of one tree, rather than recording three blooming trees. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 花の名前については、表示や確認できる資料をご覧ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: For the flower's name, please consult the signs or materials that can be checked.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: お願いします。似ている花を携帯で見つけましたが、名前はまだ確かめていません。写真に決まった名前を付ける前に確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 類似花の検索名は未確認で表示資料を確認したいと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes, please. I found a similar flower on my phone, but I have not confirmed its name yet. I will check before attaching a definite name to the photos.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say the name found by searching for a similar flower is unconfirmed and you want to check signs and reference materials. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 記録を送る相手にも、確認できた範囲をお伝えください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please also tell the person receiving the record exactly what you have been able to confirm.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。今日の場所と時刻、一本の木を撮ったことを添えます。今週ずっと満開だったという報告にはしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 今日の時刻位置と一本のみ報告し週全体の満開としないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I will include today's location and time and say I photographed one tree. I will not report that it was in full bloom all week.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will report only today's time, location, and one tree, without claiming full bloom throughout the week. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 分かりました。それでは、表示や資料をご確認ください。季節の散歩をお楽しみください。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Please check the signs and materials, then. Enjoy your seasonal walk. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 案内板の見方を確認されたいのですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like to check how to read the information board?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。子どもが来週から電車で通学します。今日は乗る予定はありませんが、一緒に表示を読む練習をしたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 来週初通学前の子供と乗車なしで掲示読取練習を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. My child will start taking the train to school next week. We do not plan to ride today, but I would like to practice reading the displays together.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you want to practice reading signs with your child before their first school commute next week, without riding today. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 行き先が分かる案内をお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do you have directions showing the destination?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 学校からもらった物があります。私が全部先に答えるより、子どもが行き先を探せるようにしたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 学校案内を示し親の代答より子供の行先探索を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: I have something from the school. Rather than answering everything first, I want my child to be able to find the destination.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show the school directions and say you want your child to find the destination rather than answering for them. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この案内板で、行き先と時刻の欄を確認できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: You can check the destination and time columns on this board.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。今日はこの表示を見ます。来週も同じ時刻だとは決めず、通う日の案内も確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 今日の表示と実通学日の時刻確認を分けると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: Thank you. We will look at this display today. I will not assume the times will be the same next week; I also want to check the information for the actual school day.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain that checking today's display and the times on the actual commuting day are separate. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 利用する日の予定については、最新の案内をご覧ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please check the latest information for the day you will travel.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。子どもに分からない時は駅員の方に聞いてよいと伝えたいです。今ここで短い質問を練習してもよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 子供が駅員へ質問する短い練習の可否を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. I want to tell my child it is all right to ask station staff when they do not understand. May we practice a short question here now?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask whether your child may practice asking station staff a short question. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 周りのお客様に配慮しながら、案内についてお尋ねください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please ask about the information while being considerate of other passengers.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: では、本人から行き先の欄を聞いてもらいます。私が急かさず、どこを確認したか一緒に振り返ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 本人質問を促し確認箇所を親子で振返ると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: Then I will have my child ask where the destination column is. I will avoid rushing them, and we will review together which part they checked.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will encourage your child to ask personally and review together what they checked. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、ご一緒にご確認ください。通学が始まりましたら、お気をつけてご利用ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please check it together, then. Travel safely when the school commute begins.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お手続きの説明で、言葉のお手伝いが必要ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Do you need language assistance with the explanation of the procedure?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。住所や名前は日本語で言えますが、理由を詳しく話すときは言葉が出なくなります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 氏名住所は日本語可だが理由説明には支援が必要と伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I can say my address and name in Japanese, but I cannot find the words when explaining my reasons in detail.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you can give your name and address in Japanese but need help explaining your reasons. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: どのようなご用件か、分かる範囲で教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please tell me what you need help with, as far as you can.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 以前の申請について相談したいです。最初の情報は自分で話し、その後の説明で通訳をお願いできるか知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 旧申請相談で冒頭は自力説明し後半通訳を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: I want to ask about a previous application. I will give the initial information myself, and I want to know whether I can request an interpreter for the explanation afterward.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you will explain the initial information about your previous application yourself and want an interpreter for the later part. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 利用できる言語の支援を担当に確認します。ご希望の言語を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: I will ask the person in charge about available language assistance. Which language would you prefer?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: ベトナム語です。簡単な日本語なら分かりますが、全部理解したと返事をしてしまわないようにしたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 希望言語を指定し簡単な日本語の理解範囲を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: Vietnamese. I understand simple Japanese, but I want to avoid saying I have understood everything when I have not.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Specify your preferred language and explain the extent to which you understand simple Japanese. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 担当にご希望を伝えます。ご相談の内容をメモで整理してありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: I will pass on your preference. Have you organized your questions in notes?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい、母語で書きました。これをそのまま書類として提出するのではなく、相談を説明するために使いたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 母語メモは正式提出でなく相談説明用と区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes, I wrote them in my native language. I want to use them to explain my questions, rather than submit them as official documents as they are.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Distinguish your native-language notes for explaining the consultation from documents for formal submission. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: メモの用途も担当へお伝えください。支援の方法や時間は確認後にご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please also tell the person in charge what the notes are for. We will explain the assistance method and timing after checking.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。今すぐ通訳がいると思わず、利用方法を聞きます。自分で分かる部分と支援が必要な部分を伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 即時通訳を前提とせず方法を聞き必要範囲を伝えると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. I will ask how to use the service instead of assuming an interpreter is available immediately. I will explain which parts I understand myself and which parts I need help with.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will ask how to get help without assuming immediate interpretation and explain where assistance is needed. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。それでは、担当へ確認します。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Certainly. I will check with the person in charge. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 待ち時間についてお尋ねでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you asking about the waiting time?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。職場へ、午前中に戻れると伝えていましたが、まだ診察を待っています。どのように連絡するか考えています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 予定した午前復職に間に合うか不明で待機状況を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I told my workplace I could return during the morning, but I am still waiting to see the doctor. I am thinking about how to let them know.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about your waiting situation because you do not know whether you can return to work during the morning as planned. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 正確な診察の終了時刻は、今はお約束できません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: We cannot promise an exact finishing time for your consultation now.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 分かりました。何時に終わると決めて連絡するより、まだ診察前だと伝えたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 確定終了時間でなく診察前の状態を職場へ伝えたいと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: Understood. Rather than deciding on a finishing time to tell them, I want to say I have not seen the doctor yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you want to tell work that you have not seen the doctor yet, rather than give a definite finishing time. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 現在の受付状況について、ご案内できることを確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: I will check what we can tell you about the current registration situation.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。病名はまだ聞いていないので、職場へ勝手に病名を伝えることはしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 診断未説明なので病名を推測連絡しないと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: Please do. I have not been told a diagnosis yet, so I will not tell my workplace a disease name on my own.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you will not guess a diagnosis to tell work because none has been explained yet. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ご自身の連絡は、周りの方に配慮して行ってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please be considerate of those around you when contacting them.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。短いメッセージで、戻る時刻はまだ分からないと知らせます。電話が必要な場合の場所も確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 時刻不明をメッセージし通話が必要なら場所を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. I will send a short message saying I still do not know when I can return. I also want to check where I can make a call if necessary.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in a message that your return time is unknown, and ask where to call if a call is necessary. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 通話できる場所をご案内します。呼び出しについてもご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: I will show you where you can make calls. Please also check how you will be called for your consultation.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。ここを離れる前に呼び出しの案内を聞き、職場には分かった状態だけ伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 離席前に呼出方法を確認し既知状態だけ連絡すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: Thank you. Before leaving here, I will ask how I will be called, and tell my workplace only what I know about my situation.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will check the calling procedure before leaving your seat and report only known facts. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。それでは、連絡場所をご案内します。診察までお待ちください。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Certainly. I will show you the place to contact them. Please wait for your consultation. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 通学路についてのご相談ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like to discuss the route to school?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。子どもが歩く道に、車が見えにくい曲がり角があります。どこへ相談すればよいか知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 子供通学路の車が見えにくい角について相談先を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. There is a corner on my child's walking route where cars are difficult to see. I would like to know whom I should consult.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whom to consult about a corner on your child's school route where cars are hard to see. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 場所と、気になった状況を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please tell me the location and what concerned you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この地図の角です。朝に車が曲がって来るのを、塀の手前からは見づらく感じました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 地図で塀と朝の車の進路を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: It is this corner on the map. In the morning, I felt it was difficult to see cars coming around the corner from before the wall.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Use the map to explain the wall and the route cars take in the morning. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 交通の状況を確認するため、ご自身が見た時刻なども伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: To check the traffic situation, we will also ask when you observed it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 七時半ごろです。事故を見たわけではなく、子どもと歩いた時に気になりました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 七時半の歩行観察で事故目撃ではないと区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: Around seven thirty. I did not witness an accident; I noticed it while walking with my child.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Distinguish your observation while walking at seven thirty from witnessing an accident. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 分かりました。通学の案内について学校ともお話しされていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Understood. Have you also spoken with the school about commuting guidance?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: まだです。学校には決められた道を確認したいです。ここでは車の見え方が気になる場所を説明したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 学校へは指定路を聞き警察へは視認懸念を相談する範囲を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: Not yet. I want to check the designated route with the school. Here, I want to explain the spot where I am concerned about visibility of cars.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will ask the school about the designated route and consult the police about visibility concerns. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ご相談の内容を確認して、関係する相談先をご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will check what your concern is and direct you to the relevant consultation service.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: お願いします。道路を自分で変えたり、物を置いて車を止めたりせず、地図と見た時間を伝えて相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 自己道路改変せず地図時刻で相談すると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: Please do. I will not alter the road myself or put things there to stop cars. I will consult you using the map and the time I observed it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will consult using the map and time without modifying the road yourself. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。それでは、場所を詳しく確認します。お子様とお気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Certainly. Let us check the location in detail. Please take care on your way home with your child.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 手紙の写真について、お尋ねですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you asking about a photograph of a letter?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 友達に送った手紙の写真をもらいました。切手の上の文字が読めず、私の手紙に注意が書かれたのかと思いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 切手上の表示を自分への注意かと思い写真で相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: I received a photo of a letter I sent to a friend. I could not read the writing over the stamp and thought a warning might have been written on my letter.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about the marking above the stamp in a photo, saying you thought it might be a warning for you. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 郵便の表示を確認します。その部分を拡大して見せていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: I will check the postal marking. Could you enlarge that part and show it to me?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: ここです。日付のような数字と場所のような字がありますが、手書きの返事ではないようです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 拡大箇所の日付地名らしい字と非手書きを説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: Here. There are numbers that look like a date and letters that look like a place name, but it does not seem to be a handwritten reply.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain the date-like numbers and place-like letters in the enlarged area and that they are not handwritten. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: こちらは消印の表示ですね。封筒の写真で見える部分をご説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: This is a postmark. I will explain the part visible in the envelope photo.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 消印という言葉は初めて聞きました。友達からの返事や、私への注意の文章ではないのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 消印語を学び相手返事とは別と理解を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: This is the first time I have heard the word “postmark.” So it is not a reply from my friend or a written warning to me, is it?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Confirm that you have learned the word “postmark” and understand it is separate from the recipient's reply. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい。相手のメッセージとは別です。写真で読めない部分は断定できません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Correct. It is separate from their message. We cannot be certain about parts unreadable in the photo.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 分かりました。届いた日だと思っていましたが、そこも数字だけで決めないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 数字のみを到着日と断定しないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: Understood. I thought it was the delivery date, but I will avoid deciding that just from the numbers too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will not assume the numbers alone show the arrival date. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 日付の表示の意味は、読める内容を確認してからご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will explain the meaning of the date marking after checking what can be read.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: お願いします。友達には、消印の意味を聞いていると伝えます。写真にない文章まで想像して返事をしないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 消印意味を質問中と友人へ伝え不存在の文を想像しないと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: Please do. I will tell my friend I am asking about what the postmark means. I will avoid replying based on imagined writing that is not in the photo.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will tell your friend you are asking about the postmark and will not imagine text that is not there. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。それでは、見える表示をご説明します。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Certainly. I will explain the visible markings. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: この説明で、ご不明な言葉はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are there any words in this explanation that you do not understand?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 「翌営業日」が分かりません。カレンダーの次の日なのか、窓口が開く日なのか知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 翌営業日が翌日か開業日か意味を質問する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: I do not understand “next business day.” I want to know whether it means the next calendar day or a day when the counter is open.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether “next business day” means the next day or the next day of operation. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 翌営業日は、その手続きを扱う営業日のうち、次の日という意味です。カレンダーの翌日とは限りません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: The next business day means the next day among the business days on which that procedure is handled. It is not necessarily the next calendar day.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: お願いします。土曜日の次は日曜日と数えましたが、普通の翌日とは違うかもしれませんね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 土曜翌日日曜という暦の数え方との違いを認める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: Please explain. I counted Sunday as the day after Saturday, but this may differ from an ordinary next day.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Acknowledge the difference from counting Sunday as the calendar day after Saturday. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: ご相談の手続きと、予定の日付を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please tell me which procedure you are asking about and your planned date.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: この手続きです。今週末に準備しようとしていますが、ここで示された日をどう読むか確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 対象手続きと週末準備予定を示し読み方を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: This procedure. I am planning to prepare this weekend, but I want to check how to interpret the date shown here.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Specify the procedure and your weekend preparation plan and check how to read the date. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 例えば土日を休みとする手続きで、月曜日が祝日でなければ、金曜日の翌営業日は月曜日です。実際の日は、この手続きの案内で確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: For example, if a procedure is not handled on Saturdays or Sundays and Monday is not a holiday, the next business day after Friday is Monday. We will check the actual date in the guidance for this procedure.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: その例なら月曜日ですね。言葉の意味は分かりました。私の手続きの日付は、条件を見て別に確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 仮定例の月曜を理解し自己手続実日付は別確認したいと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: In that example, it is Monday. I understand the term now. I want to check the conditions separately for the actual date of my procedure.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you understand Monday in the hypothetical example and want a separate check of your procedure's actual date. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 実際の予定は、手続きの条件を確認してからご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will explain your actual schedule after checking the procedure's conditions.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。まず例で意味を確かめ、その後で私の場合の予定を聞きます。家族にも同じ区別で伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 例の語義後に自己予定を確認し家族へ区別して伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. First I will check the meaning through the example, then ask about the schedule in my case. I will make the same distinction when telling my family.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will understand the example first, then confirm your own schedule and explain the distinction to your family. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 例と実際の日付を分けて確認できました。それでは、この手続きの案内をご覧ください。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: We have checked the example and actual date separately. Please now read the guidance for this procedure. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 袋のロールで、お困りですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you having trouble with the roll of bags?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 一枚だけ取りたかったのですが、何枚もつながって出ました。どこで切ればよいか分かりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 野菜袋ロールを多枚引出し切断位置を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: I wanted just one, but several came out connected. I do not know where to tear them apart.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you pulled several vegetable bags from the roll and ask where to separate them. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 引くのを止めてください。切れ目の所を一緒に確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please stop pulling. Let us check the perforation together.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい、これ以上は引きません。袋を全部かばんへ入れる前に、必要な一枚を取りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 引出を止め全部収納せず一枚のみ必要と伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes, I will not pull any more. I want to take the one I need before putting all the bags in my handbag.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you have stopped pulling and need only one bag, rather than putting them all away. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: こちらの切れ目を使います。余分に出た分は、売り場で扱いを確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Use this perforation. We will check with the section staff how to handle the extra bags you pulled out.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。自分でロールに巻き戻すと絡まりそうなので、そのままお見せします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 自己巻戻で絡ませず出た状態を示すと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: Thank you. I might tangle them if I rewind them onto the roll myself, so I will show them to you as they are.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you will show the bags as they came out, without tangling them by rewinding them yourself. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 床には落ちていませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Have they fallen on the floor?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 先の一枚は床に触れました。それと、まだ床に触れていない部分を分けてお伝えします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 先端一枚の床接触と未接触部分を分けて説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: The first bag touched the floor. I will explain separately which bag did and which part has not touched it yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Distinguish the first bag that touched the floor from the part that has not. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 状態を確認します。お使いになる袋についてもご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will check their condition. We will also guide you about the bag you will use.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: お願いします。触れた袋を黙って戻さず、余分な分をお任せします。次は切れ目を見て一枚ずつ取ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 汚れ袋を黙って戻さず職員に任せ次回切れ目を確認すると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: Please do. I will not quietly put back the bag that touched the floor; I will leave the extra bags to you. Next time I will look for the perforation and take one at a time.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will leave the dirty and extra bags to staff instead of quietly returning them, and check the perforation next time. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。それでは、こちらで確認します。お買い物をお楽しみください。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Certainly. We will check them here. Enjoy your shopping. Goodbye.
